title: Plan the Week smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Plan the Week craftbook: the week's eight events come from a live fake calendar service, and report.md shapes the days with the agenda-less meetings flagged for prep, the Tuesday conflict named, and focus blocks defended.
prompt: monday again — can you pull the week from the calender service and lay out a plan in report.md? theres a probe script wired to the fake calendar, and my open followups are in the workspace too

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for week-plan. The calendar is wired as a live fake service — endpoints in mocks/services.md, and the ready-made mock-probe project script fetches the week's events. Open follow-ups are seeded at followups.json; the deliverable is report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Plan the Week craftbook/template, pull the week's events from the fake calendar service through the provided probe, fold in the open follow-ups, and write report.md. No real services, credentials, or live calendars — only the wired mock.

mocks.description: Fake calendar service for this eval. GET /api/events returns the current week's events with times, attendees, and agendas (null agenda means nobody wrote one).
Provenance-trusted project script `mock-probe` that fetches the week's events from the fake calendar through http.authed and returns the raw response.

success.summary: report.md is a Monday-morning week plan grounded in the live fake calendar: all five weekdays shaped, the agenda-less meetings in the prep queue, the Tuesday overlap named with a proposed fix, and focus blocks placed.

checks.label: the week is laid out day by day, starting Monday
the plan reaches the end of the week
the calendar conflict is called out
focus blocks are placed and defended
the agenda-less vendor sync from the live calendar is in the plan
the agenda-less client demo from the live calendar is in the plan
the overlapping 1:1 is seen, not skipped

axes.name: coverage
axes.description: Every event from the calendar week appears in the plan; nothing is silently dropped and nothing is invented.

axes.name: prioritization
axes.description: Focus blocks land in real gaps, the biggest work gets the biggest gap, and follow-ups sit on days with room.

axes.name: conflict-handling
axes.description: The overlapping pair is named with a concrete proposed fix the owner can accept in one decision.

axes.name: realism
axes.description: The load picture is honest — heavy days are called heavy, and no day is over-packed to look tidy.
